scope: M07-G01 through M07-G15 bounded local development under ADR-0031, ADR-0033 and ADR-0034
observed_scope: Bounded SQLite commerce with separate synthetic Woo, gateway and message ledgers; common HTTP lifecycle, independent local runtime clients, adapter conformance, evidence-bound compatibility, merchant transfer with current suppression and quarantine, shared migration ownership, executable operator drills, and offline installation/upgrade preparation. G11–G15 add measured local recovery and load/backpressure, offline release security/provenance, privacy storage/source coverage and scoped export additions, and accessible keyboard/error/focus workflows.
missing: formal M05-G99 and M06-G99 acceptance and accepted M07 prerequisites
connected Woo account, complete source history, exact deployed versions and authorized scopes
connected original gateway payment/refund records and verified financial stages
connected message account, consent, source acceptance and delivery observations
model/provider intended-use and runtime qualification beyond deterministic local clients
PostgreSQL and React target-stack plus direct served-browser qualification
human authorization for public fixture publication or a tagged release
independent clean-machine installation/upgrade observation against a released artifact
current full acceptance gate and separately authorized live migration/cutover qualification
approved deployment hardware/workload recovery and performance targets plus actual provider waiting/queue observations
authenticated current vulnerability/security scans, independently reviewed artifact provenance and licensing decisions
deployment-wide provider/caller/cache/backup retention and physical erasure observations
human screen-reader, touch device, zoom and target-stack accessibility qualification
limits: All new capability objects remain proposed_not_accepted.
A composed Woo RMA retains native_return_id:null and creates no native return operation.
Manual refund records remain external-settlement pending. Gateway acceptance alone is not settlement.
No role permissions are expanded; qualified agent preview execution still requires separate approval and cannot dispatch money.
Browser evidence is component-plus-real-local-HTTP with browser egress blocked.
Both inventory views validate all 170 current tables; the old 167 projection is labelled legacy M06.
Logical erasure blocks further core use without claiming deletion of independent source or gateway retention.
Compatibility/readiness outputs are diagnostic and never authorize execution or production use.
Merchant import requires a separately verified current erasure checkpoint and keeps egress, old operations and credential references paused.

Migration binds a single-merchant installation and compares current effect authority; verified import normalization cannot activate a writable target, and rollback pauses both writers without resuming old work.
Installation tests use fresh directories on the same host; source preparation is not a released or tagged distribution.
The current development batch uses focused checks; previous full-gate evidence is historical and is not relabeled as a current full pass.
Webhook intake capacity is an explicit server-local option; existing unconfigured behavior remains unchanged. Acknowledgment still follows durable persistence.
Measured recovery and load outputs record this host and synthetic work only; source ages are not proof of actual data loss.
Release audit inventories actual artifact bytes and blocks missing/high findings; JSON pins do not authenticate a scanner, reviewer or release authority.
Privacy inventory checks all current SQLite tables and runtime source drift; it cannot discover arbitrary live caches or delete independent caller/provider copies.
Accessibility evidence covers automated rendered keyboard/DOM behavior with an explicit local API bridge; no human screen-reader observation is inferred.
evidence: Historical first-five and next-five evidence is retained separately. The G11–G15 checkpoint binds its exact source to one bounded four-file selection, targeted fault assertions, focused nonauthor reviews and cumulative native Git history. The source record alone proves no passing test or formal acceptance.
